identity: Original live-action sports drama at an outdoor world championship kart race at golden hour. Always the SAME fictional 28-year-old Hong Kong Chinese man Kai from reference 1, same angular clean-shaven face, dark eyebrows, ivory helmet with one yellow stripe, charcoal suit with yellow shoulders and red gloves, driving the same red-and-cream go-kart. Natural 35mm photography, amber sunlight, racing action and engine sound, no speech, no titles.
shots: Tense portrait on the front row. Push in on Kai's eyes through the clear visor as red start lights glow behind him. He squeezes the wheel with a red glove and exhales, the reigning champion beside him. Kart engines idle.

Wide trackside shot at wheel height. Green start lights. The black rival kart surges off the grid while Kai's red kart hesitates, then lurches forward after it. Pan as both race away into the first corner.
Side tracking shot on the final lap. Kai in the red kart chases the rival's black kart ahead of him, closing the gap approaching a hairpin. His eyes lock on the apex, the grandstand races past.

Overhead three-quarter tracking shot. Two racing karts enter a tight hairpin. The black rival runs wide. Kai clips the red and white inside curb in his red-and-cream kart and pulls alongside in one smooth arc.
Finish line camera with a checkered flag in the foreground. Kai streaks over the finish stripe a nose ahead of the black kart. Snap pan follows the red kart as the crowd erupts.

After the race, medium close-up on the first-place podium. The SAME male driver Kai wears his charcoal yellow suit and ivory open-visored helmet. He raises a silver champion's cup with red gloves and laughs in disbelief as gold confetti falls. Push in toward his smile.
captions: 阿啟：離世一，只差呢場決賽。
死火！排頭位都俾人過咗。
呢條內線，我練咗一千次。
世界冠軍——香港車手，阿啟！
